name: Tonoda Miyoko
source:
Mother of the protagonist. A widow.

She is cheerful and kind, but when it comes to her son, she is a troubled woman who is unstoppable. She is a good provider for the family while loving her son, who is becoming more and more like her husband.

She is not very good at housework, so she is dependent on her son, and is also mentally dependent on him. When her son comes home, she can't help but hug him.

Before she knew it, she noticed that her son's physique had grown to look just like her late husband's, and she became conscious of him as a man.

[From [url=http://www.r18game.com/tougenkyo/musuko/chara.html]official site[/url]]
